Actualmente se utiliza como vivienda entrada directamente desde la calle es rectangular y muy bien ubicado ideal inversión ya que está alquilado actualmente por 600€ y los propios inquilinos que llevan unos 10 años quieren quedarse ahí, si el nuevo dueño quiere, si no se marchan.

inv.desc_en:
It is currently used as a dwelling with a direct entrance from the street; it is rectangular and very well located, an ideal investment as it is currently rented for €600 and the tenants themselves, who have been there for about 10 years, want to stay if the new owner wishes, otherwise they will move out.
Community fees are €43.
Waste Tax €52.
Property Tax (IBI) €180.
We can view it next week from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM or in the afternoon from 5:00 PM onwards.

We also offer:
- Broker, to manage the best mortgage on the market for you,
- Moving services,
- Lawyers, inheritance, divorces, everything you need,
- Home Staging Decoration,
- Professional Photography and Virtual Tour,
- In-house locksmith for changing keys or anything else you need,
- Handyman, for whatever you need,
- Energy Certificate, mandatory for renting or selling your home,
- Renovations, no-obligation quote,
- Technicians (plumber, electrician, gas boilers, air conditioning, appliances) 24 hours,
- Awnings, no-obligation quote,
- Alarms.
